2608.14496.title: Generating Benchmark Health Data Using a Tabular Diffusion Transformer
2608.14496.paper_summary: Cross-Tabular Data Generation (CTDG) seeks to learn a generative model from multiple heterogeneous tables and produce new synthetic tabular datasets. However, existing synthetic tabular data generation methods are largely restricted to single-input-table scenarios and struggle to effectively handle multiple heterogeneous tables with diverse feature sets. To address this limitation, we propose a two-stage framework for cross-tabular data generation. In the first stage, each heterogeneous raw table is transformed into a standardized statistical table with the same set of columns across all tables. Each statistical table captures the marginal distributions of the original columns and the pairwise correlations among them. In the second stage, a diffusion transformer model is trained to capture structural patterns across these homogeneous statistical tables and to generate synthetic statistical tables. Synthetic raw tables are subsequently reconstructed from the generated statistical tables via multivariate Gaussian sampling followed by an inverse probability integral transform. This two-stage CTDG framework enables the learning of a unified generative model from multiple heterogeneous tables and supports the generation of an unlimited number of realistic synthetic heterogeneous tables. Experimental results demonstrate high fidelity in the learned statistical representations and a favorable fidelity-diversity trade-off in the generated synthetic data, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
2608.14496.paper_summary_zh: 交叉表格數據生成（CTDG）旨在從多個異質表格中學習生成模型，並產生新的合成表格數據集。<lb/>然而，現有的合成表格數據生成方法在很大程度上僅限於單一輸入表格的場景，並且難以有效處理具有多樣特徵集的多個異質表格。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了一個兩階段的交叉表格數據生成框架。<lb/>在第一階段，每個異質原始表格被轉換為一個標準化的統計表，所有表格具有相同的列集合。<lb/>每個統計表捕捉了原始列的邊際分佈和它們之間的成對相關性。<lb/>在第二階段，訓練了一個擴散Transformer模型，以捕捉這些同質統計表之間的結構模式，並生成合成統計表。<lb/>隨後，通過多變量高斯採樣和逆概率積分變換，從生成的統計表重建合成原始表格。<lb/>這個兩階段的CTDG框架使得從多個異質表格中學習統一的生成模型成為可能，並支持生成無限數量的現實合成異質表格。<lb/>實驗結果顯示學習到的統計表示具有高保真度，並且生成的合成數據在保真度和多樣性之間達到了良好的平衡，驗證了所提出方法的有效性。
